test_type: Signal Engine v4.0 FULL AUDIT — Real-Market Precision Verification

RC1_entry_inverted.description: Entry trigger logic was INVERTED. BUY used >= (should be <=), SELL used <= (should be >=). This caused pending orders to never trigger when price dropped TO entry (BUY limit) or rose TO entry (SELL limit).
RC1_entry_inverted.before: BUY: price >= entry - 0.5 | SELL: price <= entry + 0.5
RC1_entry_inverted.after: BUY: price <= entry + 0.5 | SELL: price >= entry - 0.5

RC2_stale_cache.description: Engine used 3s TTL cache with 1s polling, meaning 2 out of 3 ticks checked STALE data. SL/TP triggers were delayed by up to 3 seconds.
RC2_stale_cache.before: Engine called get_price() which returned cached data
RC2_stale_cache.after: Engine calls get_price_fresh() which bypasses cache entirely
RC2_stale_cache.fix: Added get_price_fresh() to market_data.py, engine uses it exclusively

RC3_no_trace_logging.description: No per-signal-per-cycle evaluation logging. Impossible to diagnose why triggers failed in production.
RC3_no_trace_logging.fix: Added [TRACE] logs for EVERY signal on EVERY cycle showing exact evaluation (comparison + result)

fixes_applied.step1_trace_logging: Every signal/cycle logs: signal_id, symbol, type, state, entry, sl, tp1/2/3, price, prev_price, source, fresh, PLUS exact evaluation per check
fixes_applied.step2_absolute_conditions: BUY entry=price<=entry+eps, SELL entry=price>=entry-eps, SL=no epsilon, TP=with epsilon. Zero crossing detection.
fixes_applied.step3_cache_fix: Engine ALWAYS uses get_price_fresh() bypassing TTL cache. HTTP API still uses cached get_price().
fixes_applied.step4_sl_priority: SL evaluated FIRST in process_signal, before TP and before Entry. No epsilon on SL.
fixes_applied.step5_single_tp: get_next_tp_target returns 'closed' (not 'tp1') when tp2/tp3 are null. Signal closes immediately on TP1 hit.
fixes_applied.step6_broker_tolerance: PRICE_EPSILON=0.5 applied to Entry+TP only. SL has zero tolerance.
fixes_applied.step7_cycle_timing: Each cycle logs: processed/actions/skipped counts, duration_ms, fresh flag, sleep duration.
